drhp.business: Kriti Nutrients Limited sells branded cooking oils — Kriti-branded soybean oil, groundnut oil and mustard oil — built on a long-standing reputation for product quality and consumer/trade trust across Central India. Alongside the branded consumer business, the Company has an institutional export business and is building out value-added, protein-based food and feed ingredients drawing on its soybean-processing base, as part of a stated shift from a single-category edible-oil business toward a broader diversified foods organisation.
